articles.title_en: The importance of supply and demand for oil prices: Evidence from non‐Gaussianity
articles.title_cn: 石油价格供需的重要性：来自非高斯性的证据
articles.abstract_en: When quantifying the importance of supply and demand for oil price fluctuations, a wide range of estimates have been reported. Models identified via a sharp upper bound on the short‐run price elasticity of supply find supply shocks to be minor drivers. In turn, when replacing the upper bound with a weakly informative prior, supply shocks turn out to be substantially more important. In this paper, I revisit the evidence in a model that combines weakly informative priors with identification by non‐Gaussianity. For this purpose, a SVAR is developed where the unknown distributions of the structural shocks are modeled nonparametrically. The empirical findings suggest that once identification by non‐Gaussianity is incorporated into the model, posterior mass of the short‐run oil supply elasticity shifts toward zero and oil supply shocks become minor drivers of oil prices. In terms of contributions to the forecast error variance of oil prices, the model arrives at median estimates of just 6% over a 16‐month horizon.
articles.abstract_cn: 在量化供需对石油价格波动的重要性时，已有研究报道了广泛的估计结果。通过短期石油供给价格弹性的严格上界识别的模型发现供给冲击是次要驱动因素。相反，当用弱信息先验替代上界时，供给冲击变得重要得多。在本文中，我在一个结合弱信息先验与非高斯性识别的模型中重新审视证据。为此，开发了一个SVAR，其中结构冲击的未知分布以非参数方式建模。实证结果表明，一旦将非高斯性识别纳入模型，短期石油供给弹性的后验质量向零移动，石油供给冲击成为石油价格的次要驱动因素。就石油价格预测误差方差的贡献而言，模型在16个月的时间范围内得出的中位数估计仅为6%。

articles.title_cn: 局部投影、自相关与效率
articles.abstract_en: It is well known that Local Projections (LP) residuals are autocorrelated. Conventional wisdom says that LP have to be estimated by OLS and that GLS is not possible because the autocorrelation process is unknown and/or because the GLS estimator would be inconsistent. I show that the autocorrelation process of LP can be written as a Vector Moving Average (VMA) process of the Wold errors and impulse responses and that autocorrelation can be corrected for using a consistent GLS estimator. Monte Carlo simulations show that estimating LP with GLS can lead to more efficient estimates.
articles.abstract_cn: 众所周知，局部投影（LP）的残差存在自相关。传统观点认为，LP必须通过OLS估计，而GLS不可行，因为自相关过程未知和/或GLS估计量将不一致。我证明了LP的自相关过程可以写成Wold误差和脉冲响应的向量移动平均（VMA）过程，并且可以使用一致的GLS估计量来修正自相关。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，使用GLS估计LP可以带来更有效的估计。

articles.title_en: A new posterior sampler for Bayesian structural vector autoregressive models
articles.title_cn: 贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型的一种新后验抽样器
articles.abstract_en: We develop an importance sampler for sign restricted Bayesian structural vector autoregressive models. The algorithm nests as a special case the sampler associated with the popular Normal inverse Wishart Uniform prior, while allowing to move beyond such prior in medium sized models. We then propose a prior on contemporaneous impulse responses that provides flexibility on the magnitude and shape of the impact responses. We illustrate the quantitative relevance of the choice of the prior in an application to US monetary policy shocks. We find that the real effects of monetary policy shocks are stronger under our proposed prior than in the Normal inverse Wishart Uniform setup.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为带符号约束的贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型开发了一种重要性抽样器。该算法将流行的正态逆 Wishart 均匀先验相关的抽样器作为特例嵌套其中，同时允许在中型模型中超越此类先验。然后，我们提出了一种关于同期脉冲响应的先验，该先验在冲击响应的幅度和形状上提供了灵活性。我们在一个美国货币政策冲击的应用中说明了先验选择的定量相关性。我们发现，在我们提出的先验下，货币政策冲击的实际效应比正态逆 Wishart 均匀设置下更强。

articles.title_en: Demand estimation with infrequent purchases and small market sizes
articles.title_cn: 低频购买与小市场规模下的需求估计
articles.abstract_en: We propose a demand estimation method that allows for a large number of zero‐ sale observations, rich unobserved heterogeneity, and endogenous prices. We do so by modeling small market sizes through Poisson arrivals. Each of these arriving consumers solves a standard discrete choice problem. We present a Bayesian IV estimation approach that addresses sampling error in product shares and scales well to rich data environments. The data requirements are traditional market‐level data as well as a measure of market sizes or consumer arrivals. After presenting simulation studies, we demonstrate the method in an empirical application of air travel demand.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种需求估计方法，该方法允许大量零销售观测值、丰富的未观测异质性和内生价格。我们通过泊松到达来建模小市场规模。每个到达的消费者解决一个标准的离散选择问题。我们提出了一种贝叶斯工具变量估计方法，该方法解决了产品份额中的抽样误差，并能很好地扩展到丰富的数据环境。数据要求是传统的市场层面数据以及市场规模或消费者到达的度量。在展示模拟研究之后，我们在航空旅行需求的实证应用中演示了该方法。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how the strength of social ties is affected by the geographical location of other individuals and their social capital. We characterize the equilibrium in terms of both social interactions and social capital. We show that lower travel costs increase not only the interaction frequency but also the social capital for all agents. We also show that the equilibrium frequency of interactions is lower than the efficient one. Using a unique geocoded data set of friendship networks among adolescents in the United States, we structurally estimate the model and show that indeed agents socially interact less than that at the first best optimum. Our policy analysis suggests that, at the same cost, subsidizing social interactions yield a higher total welfare than subsidizing transportation costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究社会联系的强度如何受到其他个体的地理位置及其社会资本的影响。我们从社会互动和社会资本两方面刻画均衡。我们表明，较低的旅行成本不仅增加了互动频率，也增加了所有参与者的社会资本。我们还表明，互动的均衡频率低于有效频率。利用美国青少年友谊网络的独特地理编码数据集，我们对模型进行了结构估计，并表明确实参与者的社会互动低于最优水平。我们的政策分析表明，在相同成本下，补贴社会互动比补贴交通成本能带来更高的总福利。

articles.title_en: Capital reallocation and the cyclicality of aggregate productivity
articles.title_cn: 资本再配置与总体生产率的周期性
articles.abstract_en: Capital reallocation between firms is procyclical and leads to variations in measured aggregate productivity. In this paper, we ask how much of the cyclical variation in measured productivity is the consequence of capital reallocation. We build a heterogeneous‐firm model to study the effects of exogenous shocks to total factor productivity (TFP) and to the costs of reallocation. These shocks cause an endogenous cyclicality of measured aggregate productivity. Only a model driven by exogenous TFP shocks is able to generate both data‐consistent cyclical movements in reallocation and sizeable variations in measured aggregate productivity. We find that capital reallocation does not play a major role in amplifying aggregate productivity variations over the business cycle.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业间的资本再配置是顺周期的，并导致所测度的总体生产率发生变化。在本文中，我们探讨所测度生产率的周期性变化中有多少是资本再配置的结果。我们构建了一个异质性企业模型，以研究全要素生产率（TFP）的外生冲击和再配置成本的冲击的影响。这些冲击引起了所测度总体生产率的内生周期性。只有由外生TFP冲击驱动的模型才能同时产生与数据一致的再配置周期性变动和所测度总体生产率的显著变化。我们发现，资本再配置在放大商业周期中的总体生产率变动方面并未发挥主要作用。

articles.title_cn: 税收与转移支付的累进性与经济周期
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how tax‐and‐transfer progressivity influences aggregate fluctuations when interacting with household heterogeneity. Using a simple static model of the extensive margin labor supply, we analytically characterize how a degree of progressivity influences differential labor supply responses to aggregate conditions across heterogeneous households. We then build a quantitative dynamic general equilibrium model with both idiosyncratic and aggregate productivity shocks and show that it delivers moderately procyclical average labor productivity and a large cyclical volatility of aggregate hours relative to output. Our quantitative exercises suggest that progressivity at the bottom of the income distribution shaped by the phasing out of transfers is key for these findings. Finally, we provide suggestive empirical evidence on the heterogeneity of employment responses across the wage distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究税收与转移支付的累进性在与家庭异质性相互作用时如何影响总体波动。利用一个简单的扩展边际劳动力供给静态模型，我们从分析上刻画了累进程度如何影响异质性家庭对总体状况的差异化劳动力供给反应。然后，我们构建了一个包含异质性和总体生产率冲击的定量动态一般均衡模型，并表明该模型能产生适度顺周期的平均劳动生产率以及相对于产出的大幅周期性波动。我们的定量实验表明，由转移支付逐步退出所塑造的收入分配底部的累进性对这些发现至关重要。最后，我们提供了关于工资分布中就业反应异质性的提示性经验证据。

articles.title_en: Behavioral learning equilibria in New Keynesian models
articles.title_cn: 新凯恩斯主义模型中的行为学习均衡
articles.abstract_en: We introduce Behavioral Learning Equilibria (BLE) into a multivariate linear framework and apply it to New Keynesian DSGE models. In a BLE, boundedly rational agents use simple, but optimal AR(1) forecasting rules whose parameters are consistent with the observed sample mean and autocorrelation of past data. We study the BLE concept in a standard 3‐equation New Keynesian model and develop an estimation methodology for the canonical Smets and Wouters (2007) model. A horse race between Rational Expectations (REE), BLE, and constant gain learning models shows that the BLE model outperforms the REE benchmark and is competitive with constant gain learning models in terms of in‐sample and out‐of‐sample fitness. Sample‐autocorrelation learning of optimal AR(1) beliefs provides the best fit when short‐term survey data on inflation expectations are taken into account in the estimation. As a policy application, we show that optimal Taylor rules under AR(1) expectations inherit history dependence and require a lower degrees of interest rate smoothing than REE.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将行为学习均衡 (BLE) 引入多元线性框架，并将其应用于新凯恩斯 DSGE 模型。在 BLE 中，有限理性代理使用简单但最优的 AR(1) 预测规则，其参数与观察到的样本均值和过去数据的自相关一致。我们在标准 3 方程新凯恩斯模型中研究 BLE 概念，并开发了规范 Smets 和 Wouters (2007) 模型的估计方法。理性期望 (REE)、BLE 和恒定增益学习模型之间的赛马表明，BLE 模型优于 REE 基准，并且在样本内和样本外适应度方面与恒定增益学习模型具有竞争力。当在估计中考虑通货膨胀预期的短期调查数据时，最优 AR(1) 信念的样本自相关学习提供了最佳拟合。作为政策应用，我们表明 AR(1) 期望下的最优泰勒规则继承了历史依赖性，并且需要比 REE 更低程度的利率平滑。

articles.title_en: Costly information acquisition in centralized matching markets
articles.title_cn: 集中匹配市场中的昂贵信息获取
articles.abstract_en: When applying to a university, students and their parents devote considerable time acquiring information about university programs in order to form preferences. We explore ways to reduce wasteful information acquisition, that is, to help students avoid acquiring information about out‐of‐reach schools or universities, using a market design approach. Focusing on markets where students are ranked by universities based on exam scores, we find that, both theoretically and experimentally, a sequential serial dictatorship mechanism leads to higher student welfare than a direct serial dictatorship mechanism. This is because the sequential mechanism informs students about which universities are willing to admit them, thereby directing their search. Our experiments also show that the sequential mechanism has behavioral advantages because subjects deviate from the optimal search strategy less frequently than under the direct mechanism. Furthermore, providing historical cutoff scores under the direct mechanism can increase student welfare, especially when the information costs are high, although the observed effect is weaker than that of a sequential mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 在申请大学时，学生及其父母会投入大量时间获取关于大学项目的信息以形成偏好。我们探索减少浪费性信息获取的方法，即通过市场设计方法帮助学生避免获取关于遥不可及的学校或大学的信息。聚焦于学生根据考试成绩被大学排名的市场，我们在理论和实验上均发现，序贯独裁机制比直接独裁机制带来更高的学生福利。这是因为序贯机制告知学生哪些大学愿意录取他们，从而引导他们的搜索。我们的实验还表明，序贯机制具有行为优势，因为受试者偏离最优搜索策略的频率低于直接机制。此外，在直接机制下提供历史分数线可以增加学生福利，尤其是在信息成本高时，尽管观察到的效果弱于序贯机制。
